title: Voila Quebec Walking Tour
blurb:
Enjoy a unique, human-scale experience that immerses you in the daily life of Québec City, from past to present. Accompanied by a passionate local guide, you'll discover iconic landmarks and lesser-known characters who helped shape the city through anecdotes, personal stories, and urban legends.

In a friendly and interactive atmosphere, you'll have plenty of opportunities to connect with fellow travelers while receiving practical recommendations for the rest of your stay, including restaurants, cafés, boutiques, museums, scenic viewpoints, and must-see attractions.

The tour concludes with a 30 minute Q & A session in a traditional Irish pub, the perfect opportunity to get personalized suggestions tailored to your interests.

An authentic introduction to Québec City that helps you understand the city through the people who lived here and those who continue to give it its unique character today.
